intro.title: Board State
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build the foundation for a Tic-Tac-Toe game by implementing board state management in Angular. You'll learn how to represent game data using TypeScript arrays and objects, and how to track the current state of the game board. The core programming concept focuses on state management - storing, updating, and displaying dynamic data that changes as users interact with your application. You'll work with Angular components, TypeScript data structures, and property binding to create a reactive game board that updates in real-time. By the end of this lesson, you'll have a functional game board that can display X's and O's in the correct positions and track whose turn it is to play.
intro.usecase: Board state management is essential in interactive applications like project management tools (Trello, Asana), chess or game platforms, and data visualization dashboards where users manipulate grid-based content. In Angular applications, you'll implement board state when building kanban boards, calendar interfaces, seating charts, or any UI where items can be moved, added, or removed from specific positions. This pattern is also crucial for form builders, spreadsheet-like interfaces, and inventory management systems where tracking the position and status of elements across a structured layout is required. Enterprise dashboards frequently use board state to manage widget placement, allowing users to customize their workspace by dragging and rearranging components.
